theme_concept_and_mood.vibe_description: A sophisticated, high-contrast hybrid design system combining deep command-center navy hues (#070B14) with luminous electrical cobalt (#1E50FF) and dynamic crimson accent pulses (#FF2E4C). Replaces generic cybersecurity clichés with refined technical geometry, glassmorphism cards with glowing perimeter traces, subtle laser grid textures, and smooth Lenis scrollytelling.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain all Next.js App Router structure, routes, content data in content.ts, and MongoDB /api/contact logic.
Implement the new color system, Tailwind custom utilities, glassmorphism card surfaces, and updated Framer Motion specs.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for E2E verification.
Ensure no text collision by maintaining minimum p-6 or p-8 inside cards with borders.
Ensure background color of Header dropdowns and sticky overlays are NEVER completely transparent (use backdrop-blur with minimum 75% dark overlay).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or plain flat gray cards.
Layer depth using z-index hierarchy and multi-layered glow shadows.
Always specify explicit hover text colors to prevent invisible text states.
Include data-testid on all key interactive elements.
Maintain high APCA contrast ratios for text accessibility.
